title: Ujima Cafe Pumpkin Party x Dorchester Food Co-op
description: The last Ujima Cafe of Boston Ujima Project's 2026 season: an evening of community and pumpkin painting at Dorchester Food Co-op (195 Bowdoin St, Dorchester), a member of Ujima's Good Business Alliance. Ujima Cafe is a casual hangout that doubles as office hours, with free coffee, snacks, and curated menus — among the lowest-effort ways to meet this community in person. Starts 5pm; RSVP on Ujima's events page.
